activities.activity_description: Add configuration option to change default Sqoop metastore; modify metastore setup logic; update configuration properties; write tests.

activities.activity_name: Write documentation for HDFS-backed module registry (U2)
activities.activity_description: Create or update AsciiDoc documentation describing how to configure the HDFS backed module registry as per XD-2287.

activities.activity_name: Implement REST API for all metrics (U3)
activities.activity_description: Design and implement new endpoints /metrics/counters/all, /metrics/gauges/all, /metrics/rich-gauges/all; add corresponding service methods; write tests.
Create a Spring Boot application class ModuleRunner that starts the XD module without traditional container; add auto-configuration; ensure compatibility; write tests.

activities.activity_name: Implement GF source with native authentication (U5)
activities.activity_description: Modify the GF source to support native authentication; add configuration properies for security; write corresponding documentation; write tests.
Create batch job that reads from JDBC and writes to HAWQ/GPDB via gpfdist; reuse existing gpfdist sink; configure job parameters; write tests.

activities.activity_name: Separate mocks from real repository in tests (U7)
activities.activity_description: Refactor test infrastructure to remove coupling between mocks and real repostories; create thin abstraction layer; update all affected tests.

activities.activity_name: Move reactor-based data processor module to core (U8)
activities.activity_description: Relocate the spring-xd-reactor module from external repo into core package; update imports and dependencies; ensure compatibility; write tests.
